The test itself states the intended control flow: with a two-locale `Faker(["fr_FR", "ja_JP"])`, calling `fake.parse("{{ name }}")` should fail in the proxy before any generator `parse` runs.

Reading `faker/proxy.py` confirms the mechanism. In `Faker.__getattribute__`, only the special attribute `"seed"` is intercepted; all other attributes fall through to normal lookup via `super().__getattribute__` (lines 107–120). Since `parse` is not a declared attribute on the proxy instance itself, Python proceeds to `Faker.__getattr__` (lines 122–139). So resolving `fake.parse` on a proxy can indeed reach `__getattr__`.

Inside `Faker.__getattr__`, the key branch is:
- if there is exactly one factory, delegate with `getattr(self._factories[0], attr)` (line 129–130),
- else if `attr in self.generator_attrs`, raise `NotImplementedError` immediately (lines 131–133),
- otherwise select a factory and delegate (lines 137–139).

The test constructs `Faker(["fr_FR", "ja_JP"])`, and `Faker.__init__` shows that when more than one locale is supplied, it creates one nested `Faker` per locale and stores them in `_factories` (lines 50–57, 80–92). Therefore this outer proxy has `len(self._factories) > 1`.

Now I need to verify whether `parse` is in `generator_attrs`. At class definition time, `generator_attrs` is built from `dir(Generator)`, excluding dunder names and only `seed`, `seed_instance`, and `random` (lines 27–29). In `faker/generator.py`, `Generator` defines a `parse` method at lines 161–175, so `parse` is included in `dir(Generator)` and is not excluded. Therefore for a multi-locale proxy, resolving `fake.parse` must enter `Faker.__getattr__` and then hit the `attr in self.generator_attrs` branch, raising `NotImplementedError`.

That same branch is what prevents any delegation to a generator instance. The only place a generator `parse` body could run is `Generator.parse` itself (lines 161–175), but `Faker.__getattr__` raises before returning any delegated attribute when `attr == "parse"` in multi-locale mode. So the generator method body is unreachable for this call.
